Overview.Name: Navya Kandakatla
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (120 g) pan fried + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g) + paneer cubes (100 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs ~120 g total) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs ~120 g total) + vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS, always start meals with paneer or eggs before eating rice.
Keep a fixed daily routine to support hormone balance.
For cravings, eat your regular meal first and wait 10 minutes before taking anything extra.
Avoid fried foods and outside snacks as much as possible.
Consistency will improve fat loss, energy and mood over time.
